The '''25 May 2024 KublaCon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament at KublaCon on 25 May 2024.<ref name="dc-1240876173219725354">"we are having a Star Wars CCG tournament at Kublacon, on May 25th!", KublaConCCG in #find-a-game, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (17 May 2024).
